notes.title: My Little Farmies - Autumn Event
notes.content: [p]Autumn isn’t just about colorful leaves – it’s also bringing a wave of creativity to My Little Farmies! The new autumn event is all about clever minds, brilliant inventions, and exciting discoveries.[/p][p]Place invention-themed decorations such as the telescope, the printing press, and Leonardo’s aerial screw. Each decoration you place will grant you a certain number of Eyeglasses. The more you collect, the greater your rewards![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31996989/8240a43a0a97fa62a897be8ea0dd0791b3f84c25.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the Friends Shop, you’ll also find the Planning Board and the Large Horse Plow as special decorations you can gift to fellow players. This way, you can help each other turn your farms into true centers of knowledge.[/p][p]Of course, there are fantastic rewards once again, including Gold Boosters and warehouse expansions. But the highlight of this autumn event is the brand-new Schoolhouse! For the first time, you’ll be able to produce items like the ruler, slate, and schoolbag – perfect for all the small and big thinkers on your farm.[/p][p]The autumn event runs until September 23 at 10:59 am CEST. So join in, set up your decorations, and let the spark of invention light up your village![/p]

notes.title: Summer Event in My LIttle Farmies
notes.content: [p]The summer event "Venetian Summer" is live in [i]My Little Farmies[/i] until June 24 at 10:59 AM CEST. During the event, you'll place special decorations that grant a fixed number of masks.[/p][p]At the end of the event, all collected masks will be counted, and you'll be able to claim your rewards. In addition to boosters and premium stalls, the grand prize is the Merchant Caravel — an exceptional market stall that allows you to achieve the highest sales prices ever.[/p][p]In line with the event theme, you also have the chance to obtain the brand-new world wonder St. Mark's Bell Tower in the Hot Deals.[/p][p][img src="https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0617_2025_MLF_summer_event_640_250.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Birthday Event
notes.content:
During this birthday event, you can set up decorations that have a fixed "Birthday Muffin" value. As the main reward, the Wonder of the World "The Joyful Farmies Party“ awaits you, which regularly drops gifts.
[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0318_2025_MLF_birthday_event_640_250.jpg[/img]
The Amazingly Beautiful Country Castle for the Castle Region is brand new in your in-game shop and only available for two weeks. You will receive 1,650 premium points every 20 hours.

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0318_2025_MLF_beautiful_country_castle_640_250.jpg[/img]

In addition, further events are starting in the game. Today we start with a double booster week. So for every booster you buy, you get a second one for free. In addition, every silver booster is guaranteed to contain a card piece for the Olive Tree and every gold booster contains a card piece for the Greek Restaurant.

The loyalty booster week starts tomorrow. When you log in, you will definitely receive a silver booster and from the fourth day in a row even a gold booster.

But that's not all. Mark March 21 red in your calendar. Then you will receive the NPC Amos when you log in first within the next 7 days. He will give you valuable products with higher chances.

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0318_2025_MLF_amos_640_250.jpg[/img]

Only on March 21, the NPC Rose will be waiting for you in the daily log in calendar. With her, the chances of getting rare or unique card parts are increased.

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0318_2025_MLF_rose_640_250.jpg[/img]

Finally, if you buy at least 200 gold bars, you can now choose to receive a homestead or a premium stand instead of the still available Mandarin Duck!

notes.title: New Travel Region China
notes.content:
You can now explore the new[b] China travel region[/b] and discover new monuments and findings. As main reward, you can earn the [b]Chinese Pavilion[/b].

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0304_2025_MLF_travel_region_china_640_250.jpg[/img]

If you purchase at least 100 gold bars, you can choose the [b]Curious Jade Snake[/b] as a free bonus gift. Alternatively, you can choose an [b]Aurochs[/b], a [b]Przewalski's Horse[/b], or a [b]Cunning Lynx NPC[/b].

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0304_2025_MLF_curious_jade_snake_640_250.jpg[/img]

In addition, your browser game is currently offering discounts on expansions to the main farm and on unlocking and expanding the regions Olaus' Sea, Friendship Valley, and Oberon's Mountains. Healthy Eating Week is also running.

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news/images/0305_2019_MLF_healthy_eating_640_250.jpg[/img]

The whole thing is rounded off by our cashback campaign. You get up to 25 percent of your spent gold bars back.

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0424_2018_MLF_cashback_640_250.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Icy expedition in My Little Farmies
notes.content:
Grab your hat and gloves and dive into the Winter Event.
Adorn your farm with decorations like a frozen boat or an igloo, and based on the "Icicle Values" of these decorations, earn fantastic rewards. How about the storage space or the wonder Ice Floe?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31996989/08951c8d1b5a6ca9067453a70f1391690f7c86b3.jpg[/img]

Of course, there's also a new bonus NPC: the Christmas Donkey. The Winter Event concludes on December 19th at 10:59 AM. Enjoy the fun with My Little Farmies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31996989/15cab89f32cacd3ef05c167a6233b1da75ef0574.jpg[/img]

notes.title: My Little Farmies catches the travel bug!
notes.content:
The travel outfitter is now offering his services in My Little Farmies. He initially entices with two very attractive destinations: Transylvania and the desert!

But before you can embark on a great adventure trip, you need to unlock the new travel region, then you'll need wagons, draft animals, and supplies for the long journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31996989/c6eed67551645e1092056436353dbedb216281c2.jpg[/img]

You create the wagons at the travel outfitter. The matching animals - Tinkers and dromedaries - are currently available in the Hot Deals and as bonus animals.

Two destinations are available to you: the desert and Transylvania. In these regions, you'll find famous buildings like the Sphinx and the Vampire Castle. You can gradually expand them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31996989/c56df8e5a682344e22d380cf918c6199b9cc76f3.jpg[/img]

Once a building is completed, you'll receive a monument point, and it regularly yields one of five special items. Once you've collected all the items in a region, you'll receive a unique wonder of the world as a reward - specifically for that particular region.

That's the new My Little Farmies travel feature in a nutshell. In the forum, you'll naturally find much more information about the details.

And? Are you in the mood for a journey?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31996989/cb750e0adf1969a1828493a9ea06e45068671139.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Valentine's Event Extended
notes.content:
Due to starting issues with our Valentine's Event and the subsequent downtime, we've decided to prolong the event's duration until February 10 at 10:00 am CET.

Also, in order to make up for the lost premium time, every player logged into the game yesterday gets a free card valid for 1 day of premium time.

In addition to that, you're able to open your Valentine coutdown's calendar doors for today (February 3) and yesterday (February 2) for free. Any player who spent gold bars on yesterday's door will get a refund.

notes.title: Shivers, swag, shenanigans
notes.content:
[h1]Your quick peek at some the Halloween events in upjers games[/h1]

The night of Halloween is looming ahead. This means it‘s party-time for upjers!

We want to give you an overview on the [b]Halloween-Events[/b] starting across many games next 
week. Here‘s what you can expect:​

[h1]My Little Farmies[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/789100/My_Little_Farmies/

From [b]October 22nd to 29th[/b] the Halloween-themed collector-event is waiting for you. Decorate your village with eeriely-cute Voodoo decorations to collect all the [b]Shrunken head[/b]-tokens to win valuable prizes like the new [b]„Saddler‘s“[/b] production facility. There you can craft saddles and other products.

[h1]My Free Zoo[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/694130/My_Free_Zoo/

Is this too morbid for you? Then you may already be looking forward to collect [b]Lionhead tokens[/b] at My Free Zoo. Put up scary-looking glow-in-the-dark animal statues to have the chance to win the adorable and very exclusive [b]Siberian musk deer[/b] to exhibit in your zoo. ([i]The events runs 
between October 23rd and 30th.[/i])

[h1]My Free Farm[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049880/My_Free_Farm/

This year the My Free Farm Halloween-Event is challenging your gray matter again! The [b]Halloween card-matching game[/b] is back! When you mange to clear all cards from the table within ten tries, you have the chance to win new amusing trophies for your collection. ([i]October 22nd 
through to November 5th[/i].)

But also your  [b]Horse Farm[/b] (24 – 30 October), [b]Wauies[/b] (24 – 31 October), [b]My Sunny Resort[/b] (23 – 30 October) and [b]My Free Farm 2[/b] (29 October – 5 November) are packed full with fun events 
to take the edge off the dark season.

notes.title: Make your friends welcome: the new visitor region in My Little Farmies
notes.content:
[h1]Double the friend rewards, gold boosters and more[/h1]


one of the factors to have a lot of fun in [b]My Little Farmies[/b] is to have lots of friends and 
visiting them regularly to help them with their farms.

Lately we added [b]a new region[/b] you can use to make your friends much more comfortable; 

The [b]visitor region[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/a16f602b9b1898b074f53ee0e91cb023231417ff.jpg[/img]

Here you can create a smaller version of your farm to welcome your friends. [b]Your benefits[/b]:

your friends will arrive on your farm much quicker (shorter loading times), they – as well as 
yourself – will get [b]a full friendship star[/b] for helping you out. And also for every 18 stars 
collected, you will get one of seven parts for a [b]gold booster[/b]!

Unlocking your visitor region, you need [b]the cartographer[/b] and have to do a few small tasks and pay a fee.

Starting at level 15, unlocking the region costs 150 gold bars while at level 40+ you may also pay in Thalers. Your tasks are:

[list][*]expanding your main farm ten times
[*]have ten friends and
[*]collect 200 friendship stars[/list]

The game starts counting from either the moment you unlock the cartographer or, if already unlocked, since the patch went live.

In turn you get a region where you can [b]place fields, decorations and animal pens[/b]. Also you can use – except for the special buildings (carriage station, servant‘s and farmhouses, contest tent, market place, stalls, the crier and the tourist info) – [b]all production buildings and workers[/b].

You see: while it‘s quite complex to get, the rewards are more than making it up for you and your 
visitors.

notes.title: Celebrating the love for the culture and cuisine of Japan
notes.content:
[b]Valentine‘s Day[/b] is not just for loving couples. Love can be found everywhere. People all over the world are proud of their love – be it for each other or something they care about deeply - and celebrate this joyous feeling.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/655c23366f09d0711560c4395d221e1dab2d5fc9.jpg[/img]

The people of [b]My Little Farmies[/b] celebrate this day too. They love different cultures and different cuisines. That is why this time, they express their love for Japan. [b]Between the 5th and 12th of February[/b] adorn your farm with [b]Valentine’s decorations[/b], collect [b]Cherryblossoms[/b] and trade these for [b]Rice plants, card pieces for the Japanese 
Trader and gold boosters[/b].

The [b]rice plant[/b] can be placed on water and the lakes of the shire. Once harvested, [b]rice[/b] is needed by the [b]Japanese trader[/b] who prepares [b]Sushi[/b] from it and other ingredients.

Cards for the trader are also available from boosters, NPC, friends and – after the event ended – also from the shop.

We would like to also mention the newest [b]bonus items[/b] you can get when purchasing packs of 100+ gold bars: [b]Cinderella[/b], who will up to four times a day present you with special items, and the [b]Premium Market Stalls[/b].

Please note: The amount of Cherryblossoms you collect is counted when you place the decorations.

At the end of the event you will receive your rewards automatically.

notes.title: Collect all the stickers and get the spinning mill
notes.content:
There is a lot to do for [b]My Little Farmies[/b]. With the introduction of the [b]tithe-barn[/b] new opportunities are arising for the farmies: All products are counted here and, on reaching the correct number, you will receive valuable rewards.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/35722395ca2a6de83d7c24aea7e08cc13ff43f64.jpg[/img]

Once you have collected all the necessary products for a certain level (level 30, 44 or 55 respectively), you will get a number of [b]cards[/b] for the following rewards: the mystical “all-in-one-breakfast-animal” (for collecting all level 30 products), the [b]Mulberry Tree[/b] (Level 44) which produces [b]silk[/b], which then, in the [b]spinning mill[/b] can be spun and woven into [b]silk yarn, silk fabric, silk scarf and dyed silk scarf[/b].

The most remarkable bit is that you can restart your collection once you received the cards to start the next stage – which will be a little bit harder but will give you more rewards.

Wishing you much fun with your new toy!

notes.title: Little Imps available now!
notes.content:
The quiet days are over! The sound of numerous imps working to expand the underground lair puts a smile on the face of even the most miserable rules of the deep. With its humorous fantasy elements, its online coop mode and unique battle features, dungeon tycoon game „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is the right game for any aspiring prince of darkness.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026505/9b43b55f5a92a4f01249e20ff71909953a39fbaf.jpg[/img]

The Steam early access version of „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is now available.

notes.title: The 2018 Christmas Event has started
notes.content:
[b]My Little Farmies[/b] are already dreaming of a white Christmas. That is why Old Mother Frost has shaken her feather beds and covered the world in a cozy blanket of snow.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/2dfa541e9d9f28a66fe8c32945d2a52773c74934.jpg[/img]

So it is now time to put up the [b]Christmas decorations[/b]. Every decoration, from the gingerbread house to every floe on the new water terrain, grants you Christmas Bauble points.

Until December 18 you can place as many decorations as you like to receive up to 30 card pieces for the new [b]dry house[/b], where you can dry cocoa, coffee, tea and more. The first piece will be yours for only 5000 points.

Wishing you a wonderful time until Christmas and much success decorating the farm.

notes.title: Expand your My Little Farmies world
notes.content:
Six regions can now be expanded with four new areas! The [b]Palace Gardens[/b], the [b]Ceres Field[/b], [b]Diana‘s Glade[/b], the [b]Sea of Flowers[/b], the [b]Floodplains[/b], and the [b]Shadow Weald[/b] are now expandable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/31341ab164bc83ff081ad446cc0b0999ddf81865.jpg[/img]

Also you may now profit from several Premium-features we have been adding as well – like being able to sell your harvest [b]straight from your homestead[/b] - making life a lot easier for your farmies.

We hope you like the newest additions to the game.

notes.title: A Fruit-Filled Event
notes.content:
Refreshments are in order! We're starting the wonderful [b]Summer Sweetness Event[/b] top help you keep up with the demands for fruit.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/572bdc6225c6105207fdfd19132d38b28d598cfb.jpg[/img]

From now until [b]Tuesday, August 14[/b], at 11:00 am CEST, [b]cherries[/b] and [b]plums[/b] will grow [b]twice as fast[/b]. Production of [b]cherry and plum juice[/b] is likewise also double the regular speed. That means you only need half as long to get some refreshing juice to sip in the shade!

Take advantage of this [b]wonderful opportunity[/b]! Sweeten up your summer and save lots of time! The farmies are looking forward to these tasty refreshments!

notes.title: Two Fantastic Events
notes.content:
You can now once again secure yourself free silver and even gold boosters. From now [b]until Tuesday, July 31[/b], you can reap the fruits of our [b]booster event[/b]. Log in [b]daily[/b] and collect a free [b]silver booster[/b] instead of the regular gold booster. Do this for [b]three days in a row[/b], and you'll start getting [b]gold boosters[/b] on the [b]fourth day[/b]. Provided, of course, you don't miss a day.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/347ba26335eb773c39b8c4b6b5f120a5c471c7bc.jpg[/img]

 Additionally, the Farmies are celebrating their very first [b]Cheese and Wine Day[/b] between [b]Wednesday, July 25[/b], at 11:00 am and [b]Thursday, July 26[/b], at 10:59 am CEST. For 24 yhours, you'll get [b]twice as much yield[/b] when producing [b]goat's cheese, smoked cheese, truffle cheese, apple wine[/b] and [b]grape wine[/b]. Use this amazing opportunity to get more cheese wine!

notes.title: More Grain with this Special Event
notes.content:
For a short time only, you can increase your [b]cereal harvest[/b] in the hit browser game [b]My Little Farmies[/b] by a whopping [b]100 percent[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/fd8b38c9d347ee7767582e5cc8d54678439ebe39.jpg[/img]

From now until [b]Tuesday, July 24[/b], at 11:00 am CEST, you'll receive [b]twice the yield[/b] when harvesting [b]wheat, barley and oats[/b]. It's a great opportunity to increase your thaler income. After all - more grain means more money! Come check out this special event. We look forward to seeing you!

notes.title: World Cup Event
notes.content:
[b]Dear Farmers[/b],

Football fever has gripped the farm! But the Farmies aren't just focusing on goals, balls and the best possible lawn care - they also see it as an opportunity to welcome other cultures into their everyday life and learn more about this year's hosts in the[b]World Cup Event[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/159dd719415b9d0d4c396384a16c266e0ec5d4b5.jpg[/img]

For the duration of the event, you'll find the seasonal section of your shop stocked with impressive [b]Russian landmarks and international banners[/b] - use them to show your enthusiasm for your team and this year's enchanting host country.

Each World Cup decoration you place on your farm will give you points in the form of [b]Footballs[/b] at [b]regular intervals[/b]. Just click on the [b]pin[/b] that appears above them to collect your Footballs.

One special decoration - the King's Gate - will instantly give you 7,500 Footballs when you charge it for 10 Gold Bars.

You can click on this icon at the right side of your playing field to see your progress. Collecting enough Footballs before the event ends on [b]July 10 at 10:59 am CEST[/b] will allow you to earn [b]tons of fertilizer[/b] for your farm!

You can also help out your friends by sending pieces of two [b]exclusive World Cup friendship gifts[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/93b6d403453d199c0d629ee99c5b3434382e063a.jpg[/img]

[list][b]25,000 Footballs[/b] - 1,000 Vegetable Fertilizer
[b]50,000 Footballs[/b] - 5,000 Fruit Fertilizer
[b]100,000 Footballs[/b] - 10,000 Fiber Fertilizer
[b]200,000 Footballs[/b] - 30,000 Herb Fertilizer
[b]400,000 Footballs[/b] - 50,000 Wood Fertilizer
[b]800,000 Footballs[/b] - 125,000 Flower Fertilizer[/list]

You read right - there are two new types of fertilizer*, which can now be made in your Fertilizer Factory! [b]Flower Fertilizer[/b] and [b]Wood Fertilizer[/b]! 

[i][b]Enjoy the game![/b][/i]

Your [b]My Little Farmies[/b] Team

* [spoiler]With these, you can accelerate the following flowers and wood:
Marigolds, Oxeye Daisies, Pink Roses, Red Tulips// Maple, Oak and Pine![/spoiler]

notes.title: May Day Celebration
notes.content:
Dear Farmers, 

May has made its festive entrance, and the villagers are happy and exhausted after an exciting May Day celebration. Now it's time to get back to work and fill the storerooms again. Luckily, the growing conditions seem to be unusually good for May, and even the corn and pumpkins seem ripe and ready shortly after being sown. The villagers are flabbergasted, but not about to question their good fortune!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/37201a72c59678ee6de7e0a09573f8ab7ed17421.jpg[/img]

From now[b] until May 29 [/b]at 10:59am CEST, your[b] pumpkins, corn and potatoes[/b] will grow [b]twice as fast[/b]! That means you'll be able to produce twice as much in the same time period and keep productions rolling!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/8fecb827c3deba5836088d68aec76416ae548505.jpg[/img]

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Mother's Day Event!
notes.content:
The gradual transition from spring to summer feels almost magical this year. While enjoying the first few walks in the lush forests, you might even get the feeling that you're being watched - not in a threatening way though. After all, there's random giggling behind every bush. Journey into a fairy tale world for this year's [b]Mother's Day Event[/b]!

For the duration of the event, you'll find the seasonal section of your shop stocked with whimsical [b]fairy tale forest decorations[/b] - give your farm a fairy tale touch with everything from cozy tree houses to flowery swings.

Each Mother's Day decoration you place on your farm will give you points in the form of [b]Toadstools[/b] at regular intervals. Just click on the pin that appears above them to collect your Toadstools.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/87a003b4237ecb697c62410457e1da945cd7f51d.jpg[/img]

Collecting enough Toadstools before the event ends on [b]May 15 at 10:59 am CEST[/b] will allow you to earn a brand-new [b]wonder of the world,[/b] the [b]Woodsman Cabin[/b]!

You can also help out your friends by sending pieces of two [b]exclusive Mother's Day friendship gifts[/b]!

If you manage to reach the highest reward tier, you'll have enough pieces for a whole Woodsman Cabin (which consists of a total of 50 pieces).

The [b]Woodsman Cabin[/b] allows you to send out a Woodsman for 6,000 Thalers, who will return from his forays in the woods with 8-12 [b]Pinewood Mushrooms, Beechnuts or Blueberries[/b].

Of course, these come with new products that can be made in your existing production buildings!

notes.title: New Guild Destinations!
notes.content:
Today's patch finally brings you [b]new destinations[/b] for your [b]guild expeditions[/b] in My Little Farmies!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/e121a22f313322674b8bb7665f6b6de42fadb186.jpg[/img]

Effective immediately, there are [b]eight new destinations[/b] available. These are much further away than current expeditions, so you'll want to prepare bigger and faster ships for these new voyages.

The [i]coordinates for these trade destinations[/i] are a well-kept secret and can be acquired in the [b]guild shop[/b] for a price (either Thalers or Gold Bars). The costs are covered by the guild funds - which means only Aldermen and Consuls can make these purchases for the guild.

Once unlocked, the following [b]new destinations[/b] can be visited:

[list][*]Torys
[*]Tamasne
[*]Azbet Nesir
[*]Karemali
[*]Cape Tarney
[*]Bemanda
[*]Kosanga-Landu
[*]Ozambonda[/list]
Since the map now encompasses a whole lot of different destinations, we've added a handy [b]compass[/b] to navigate between them.

Paired with these new destinations, there are also [b]eight new colonial goods[/b]!

Last but not least, you can now [b]fill your marketstalls[/b] straight from the [b]warehouse[/b] with a convenient button.

[b][i]Enjoy your explorations![/i][/b]

notes.title: Spring Fever!
notes.content:
There's nothing quite like the first tender and sweet grasses of spring! Winter is over, the sun is out, and the animals are ecstatic, gamboling around in the fields and enjoying life to the fullest after a dreary season cooped indoors.

From now until [b]Tuesday, April 17, at 10:59 am CEST[/b], your[b] animals will produce twice as fast[/b]! That's a lot of extra milk, feathers and wool!

You can now also look forward to summery decorations in the [b]Gem Shop[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/147efaa69280b61af807f52f167ced91db11177b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Decorate your Village and Receive Wonderful Prizes
notes.content:
You can now spruce up your village with lovely Easter ornaments. From now until [b]Tuesday, April 3[/b] at 10:59 am CEST. you'll be able to acquire [b]enchanting Easter market decorations[/b]. The selection ranges from classic decorations such as potted catkins to market stalls selling brooms and brushes, refreshing drinks and fashionable farm clothes.

 Every decoration you place will give you [b]Catkins[/b]. At the end of the event, your points will be tallied up and you'll be awarded wonderful prizes, including various amounts of vegetable, cereal, herb, fruit and fiber fertilizer and premium time card pieces.

 Additionally, you can gift your friends with stunning items from the [b]friendship shop[/b] - a pot of purple crocuses or a fraconian Easter fountain.

Come visit the Farmies for this special Easter celebration! [b]Happy Easter![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/60f41d163d1ee4ae6f73bcafb648fb68f7e68f00.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Decorate your Village and Receive Wonderful Prizes
notes.content:
You can now spruce up your village with lovely Easter ornaments. From now until [b]Tuesday, April 3[/b] at 10:59 am CEST. you'll be able to acquire [b]enchanting Easter market decorations[/b]. The selection ranges from classic decorations such as potted catkins to market stalls selling brooms and brushes, refreshing drinks and fashionable farm clothes.

 Every decoration you place will give you [b]Catkins[/b]. At the end of the event, your points will be tallied up and you'll be awarded wonderful prizes, including various amounts of vegetable, cereal, herb, fruit and fiber fertilizer and premium time card pieces.

 Additionally, you can gift your friends with stunning items from the [b]friendship shop[/b] - a pot of purple crocuses or a fraconian Easter fountain.

Come visit the Farmies for this special Easter celebration! [b]Happy Easter![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/60f41d163d1ee4ae6f73bcafb648fb68f7e68f00.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Egg Week!
notes.content:
Easter is almost here! And what would the village children do without a good Easter egg hunt? So of course, eggs are in high demand! Luckily for you, your chickens are up to the challenge!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/7e9213f171fc38ec38766681a3b93702839c3cc5.jpg[/img]

From now [b]until Tuesday, April 11,[/b] at 11:59am CEST, your [b]chickens will produce eggs twice as fast[/b]. But that's not all! Due to the high demand, your [b]customers[/b] will also [b]pay double[/b] for your eggs!

We've also added [b]10 new warehouse expansions[/b] available at[b] level 40[/b] and up - these add [b]200[/b] to your warehouse capacity and cost [b][i]150 Gold Bars[/i][/b] each (upgrades 55, 58 and 61 can also be purchased with Thalers).

[i]Last but not least:[/i]

[list][*]Valentine's decorations have been removed from the [b]Gem Shop[/b] and replaced with [b]Easter decorations[/b].
[*][b]NPCs, animals and wonders of the world[/b] in the Gem Shop now have [b]dynamic price scaling[/b] and will become increasingly expensive the more of the same ones you buy.
[*]When placing newly bought animals, you'll now find a [b]"jump to next suitable enclosure" button[/b] on the card in the card bar.[/list]

notes.title: Spring Cleaning: Production Times Halved!
notes.content:
Get out your brooms and featherdusters! Spring cleaning has begun in the [b]My Little Farmies[/b] browser game. And of course, there's a [b]great event[/b] to help out: From now [b]until Tuesday, March 6[/b], at 10:59 am CET, production of [b]maple furniture, oak barrels, jute bags[/b] and [b]linen pants[/b] will only take [b]half as long[/b]. Save time and [b]double your profits[/b] by producing twice as much in the same time.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/732bb5ffef9cfa779115a01fe61890fdb6e3771a.jpg[/img]

Come check out this special event. We wish you [b]lots of fun[/b] with the Farmies!
